app.title: Observer
app.subtitle: A privacy-preserving companion for calm focus and gentle support
app.disclaimer: Observer provides local behavioral estimates, not a clinical diagnosis or medical evaluation. All processing happens 100% on this computer.

welcome.heading: Welcome to Observer
welcome.subheading: A calm, local companion designed to notice when you're stuck without judgment.
privacyPoints: 100% Local: No video frames, images, or audio are ever saved or transmitted.
Zero Telemetry: No analytics, tracking, or network calls of any kind.
No Window Spying: Observer never reads window titles, process names, or keystrokes.
Full Control: You can pause the camera anytime or delete all stored calibration data instantly.
welcome.consentPrompt: Please review and configure what local signals Observer may observe:
welcome.toggleWebcam: Facial cues (blink rate, gaze dispersion, tension proxies)
welcome.toggleWindowSwitches: Window switch count (frequency of switching apps)
welcome.understandCheckbox: I understand that Observer runs locally, never saves images, and offers estimates rather than diagnoses.

calibration.heading: Personal Calibration
calibration.subheading: Neurodivergent focus patterns are unique. Calibration teaches Observer your personal baseline.
calibration.step1Desc: Take a breath, look naturally at your screen as if casually watching a video.
calibration.step2Desc: Look at the screen as you normally do when reading or typing.
calibration.noFaceDetected: Looking for face... please center your camera
calibration.completeDesc: Your baseline features have been saved locally. You can re-calibrate anytime.

home.whyDesc: Top observed cues contributing to this estimate:
home.noIntervention: No interventions right now. Focus or rest at your own pace.

settings.heading: Preferences & Data
settings.sensitivityDesc: Adjust how readily gentle check-ins are offered.
settings.quietHoursDesc: Silence gentle offers during specific times of day.

demo.heading: Judge & Evaluator Demo Mode
demo.subheading: Inspect the complete state detection timeline and interventions without needing a live webcam.

stages.title: Relaxed State
stages.desc: Casual video watching, natural blink cadence, relaxed brow.

stages.title: Focused Work
stages.desc: Steady typing input, engaged gaze distribution, low tension.

stages.title: Task Paralysis Emerges
stages.desc: Prolonged gaze freeze on cursor, brow furrow, zero typing.

stages.title: Gentle Intervention
stages.desc: Tier 2 offer: 'That looks stuck. Want a tiny first step?'

stages.title: Recovery & Settled
stages.desc: User breathes, shifts gaze, returns to relaxed baseline.
